title: tarrietia actinophylla
intro: Tarrietia actinophylla, commonly known as the Native Neem, is a plant species native to Australia. The health benefits of Tarrietia actinophylla include its use in treating digestive issues and its ability to exhibit antimicrobial properties, which can aid in wound healing and protecting against infections. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which can help soothe skin irritations and promote overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of Tarrietia actinophylla include various compounds such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
